description: Implementation of the 'Value' class and related classes (DictionaryValue, ListValue) for handling JSON-like data structures, including copying, comparison, and path-based access.

classes.name: Value
classes.description: Represents a dynamically typed value that can be null, boolean, integer, string, binary, dictionary, or list.

classes.name: DictionaryValue
classes.description: A dictionary (map) of string keys to Value objects, supporting nested paths and merging.

classes.name: ListValue
classes.description: A list of Value objects supporting insertion, removal, and deep copying.

methods.name: CreateWithCopiedBuffer
methods.description: Creates a Value object by copying a buffer.

methods.name: FromUniquePtrValue
methods.description: Creates a Value from a unique_ptr<Value>.

methods.name: ToUniquePtrValue
methods.description: Converts a Value into a unique_ptr<Value>.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Returns a deep copy of the Value.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the Value.
